race.title: Unibet Floodlit Stakes (Listed)
race.verdict: Successful at the highest level last summer, EL CORDOBES hasn't had things go his way in only 3 outings this year, so he is taken to get back to winning ways as he returns to listed level. Amiloc also brings Group 1 form to the table having been runner-up in last season's Irish St Leger and could be the main danger, with Constitution Hill also considered back down in grade. EL CORDOBES (IRE) AMILOC CONSTITUTION HILL
